title: Campaign Orchestra: Readiness + Capacity Tuning Sheet
content:
Purpose:
- One-page traffic/capacity/KPI orchestration sheet for staggered feature launches (internal working version).
- Goal: give product, ops, SRE, and support a single source of quick triage + decision during first 72 hours of rollouts.

Scope & constraints:
- Applies to Hosted API + Dedicated (first-line), Private rollouts follow separate runbook.
- Target cohorts: beta (10k UA/day), early (100k UA/day), ramp (1M UA/day).
- Latency SLO targets: p95 < 250ms gen path; error rate < 0.5% per route.

Quick owners (primary contacts):
- Launch lead: Ava Chen (product-ops) — overall go/no-go
- SRE oncall: Marcus Patel — infra & capacity ops
- Model & serving lead: Leah Rodriguez — model variant + fallback mapping
- Support escalation: Omar Singh — CS & incident comms

Traffic ramp schedule (recommended):
- T0 (canary): 0.1% traffic -> 30m observation -> metrics check
- T1 (small): 1% traffic -> 2 hours -> automated ramp to T2 if green
- T2 (core): 10% traffic -> 6 hours -> check orchestration gates
- T3 (wide): 50% -> 24 hours -> continuous monitor and stagger to 100% after 48h

KPI matrix (columns: metric | baseline | target | alert threshold | owner):
- Request/sec (global): baseline 800 RPS | target maintain < +/-20% | alert > +40% | Marcus
- Gen p95 latency: baseline 180ms | target < 250ms | alert > 350ms | Leah
- Token cost/unit: baseline $0.0009 | target <= $0.0011 | alert > $0.0016 | Finance (simon)
- Error rate (4xx/5xx): baseline 0.3% | target < 0.5% | alert > 1.0% | SRE
- Quality regression (Eval set): baseline pass 92% | target >= 90% | alert < 88% | Product QA
- Cache hit ratio (prefix cache): baseline 42% | target >50% | alert < 30% | Leah
- Autoscaler headroom (GPU util): baseline 68% | target 55–75% | alert > 85% | Marcus

Readiness checklist (row per item, owner, status: TODO / IN_PROGRESS / DONE / BLOCKED):
- Finalize model pin mapping + fallback chain | Leah | DONE
- Canary model artifact pushed to staging | Release Eng | DONE
- Canary traffic route + feature flag created | Platform Eng | IN_PROGRESS
- Observability dashboards (per-route SLI) published | Observability | IN_PROGRESS
- Alert runbook snippets authored for 5xx spike and latency creep | SRE | TODO
- Communication template for customer-facing status page | CS | TODO
- Post-launch eval harness (10k prompts) queued | Product QA | IN_PROGRESS
- Data retention & PII check for Private customers | Security & Compliance | DONE
- Cost cap policy configured in console | Finance/Platform | TODO

Risk register (short bullets):
- Risk: Autoscaler latency at spike -> Mitigation: pre-warm pool & conservative ramp; Rollback trigger: > 30% p95 degradation for 30m
- Risk: Quality regression on long-tail prompts -> Mitigation: holdback experiment and run targeted evals; Rollback trigger: eval drop > 4pts
- Risk: Downstream rate limiting by partner services -> Mitigation: circuit breaker + retrybackoff; Owner: Solutions Eng

Decision gates (binary checks before moving T1->T2):
- Canary SLI passes for 30m (latency, errors, CPU/GPU stability) -> yes/no
- No unrecoverable infra alerts (network, autoscaler thrash) -> yes/no
- Post-canary quality check on sample set >= threshold -> yes/no
- Cost-per-token within expected range for projected traffic -> yes/no

Staffing plan (first 48h):
- 24/7 oncall rotation: Marcus (day 0), backup Samira (day 0), Leah (model triage), Omar (CS triage)
- War room cadence: 30m stand for first 6 hours, hourly next 18 hours, twice-daily thereafter until stable

Quick runbook bits (copy/paste for Slack & status page):
- TL;DR: Canary started at 0.1% at 14:00 UTC. Monitoring p95 & errors for 30m. Primary contact: Ava (ava@redwood.ai).
- If latency > 350ms for p95 for 3 consecutive 10m windows -> pause ramp and engage SRE.
- If eval QA score drops below 88% -> pause, revert to previous model variant, notify customers via status page.

Post-launch telemetry & actions (what we collect + when to act):
- 0–6h: hourly token-cost and latency deltas, watch for autoscaler churn
- 6–24h: SLO drift reports, quality regression checks on sampled user prompts
- 24–72h: cohort retention delta & user-reported issues feed into triage board

Open questions / notes-to-self:
- Confirm cost alert ownership (Finance vs Platform billing) — @simon to confirm ticket by EOD
- Need an A/B assignment for holdback users (cohort ids list) — Solutions Eng to provide mapping
- Confirm that Dedicated customers are excluded from canary traffic by default (policy check)

Linked tickets (quick refs):
- JIRA-4567 (launch orchestration), JIRA-4621 (canary routing), JIRA-4708 (eval harness), GH#98 (feature-flag impl)

Next immediate actions (today):
1) Platform Eng: finish feature flag toggle and set auto-disable if ramp fails (owner: Platform Eng)
2) Observability: finish dashboard widgets + add synthetic probe (owner: Observability)
3) Product QA: finalize first 10k prompt eval set and schedule run (owner: Product QA)

Notes on doc tone & use:
- Working doc. Keep concise updates in the "status" column and add one-line note each time you change a gate decision (timestamped).
- After 72h, convert to postmortem template and move into Confluence page linked above.

-- END SHEET --
